title: Bodycam: Woman Allegedly Threatened McDonald’s Customers with Butcher Knife
description:
Police responded to a Hoboken McDonald’s after customers called 911 and said a woman was threatening people with what appeared to be a butcher knife. Bodycam footage shows New Jersey police arriving on the scene and immediately confronting the suspect. Amanda Hernandez was allegedly threatening people in Starbucks before making her way to McDonald’s when police were called. An arrest report shows Hernandez faces numerous charges including aggravated assault and unlawful possession of a weapon, among other charges. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
